Another supplier offers 20 $\times$ 450 g packs of sugar cubes at ₦5,999. She wants to do a quick calculation to make a decision. She needs to approximate the price of on
record.prompt_text: A shop owner has to choose the supplier from which she will order sugar cubes. One supplier offers 50 $\times$ 450 g packs of sugar cubes at ₦19,599. Another supplier offers 20 $\times$ 450 g packs of sugar cubes at ₦5,999. She wants to do a quick calculation to make a decision. She needs to approximate the price of one pack.
record.answer_text:
Step 1: Decide what operation must be done: addition, subtraction, multiplication or division.
Since the mass of the packs of sugar cubes are the same at both suppliers, the shop owner must determine the cost per pack.
She must divide the total cost by the number of packs.

Step 2: Round the numbers to multiples of ten that will allow an easy calculation.
Round both costs to the nearest thousand:
₦19,599 ≈ ₦20,000
₦5,999 ≈ ₦6,000
The numbers of packs are already given as a multiple of ten for both suppliers.

Step 3: Do the calculation with the approximate values.
₦20,000/50=₦400 for one pack
₦6,000/20=₦300 for one pack
The price for one pack is lower for the supplier that offers 20 packs at ₦5,999.

record.prompt_text:
### Exercise 7.10: Use estimation and approximation to solve problems

4. A university student rents a flat at ₦82,250 per month. She works out that her rent for the year is going to be ₦98,700 and lets her mother know. Her mother immediately sees that the amount cannot be correct. Do a rough check to determine what is wrong with the calculation.
record.answer_text:
$$\begin{align}
₦82,250\times 12 &\approx ₦82,000 \times 10 \\
&\approx ₦820,000 \\
\end{align}$$
The student probably left out a zero. The amount should be ₦987,000.

record.evidence_quote: ### Exercise 7.10: Use estimation and approximation to solve problems 8. A supermarket has special offers on milk powder. One offer is two 1 kg tins at ₦7,595. Another offer is four 400 g tins at ₦6,399. Do a quick calculation to determine which offer is the cheapest.
record.prompt_text:
### Exercise 7.10: Use estimation and approximation to solve problems

8. A supermarket has special offers on milk powder. One offer is two 1 kg tins at ₦7,595. Another offer is four 400 g tins at ₦6,399. Do a quick calculation to determine which offer is the cheapest.
record.answer_text:
Offer 1:
$$\begin{align}
\frac{₦7,595}{2\times1\text{ kg}} &\approx \frac{₦7,600}{2} \\
&\approx ₦3,800\text{/kg} \\
\end{align}$$
Offer 2:
$$\begin{align}
\frac{₦6,399}{4\times400\text{ g}} &\approx \frac{₦6,400}{1.6} \\
&\approx ₦4,000\text{/kg} \\
\end{align}$$
Offer 1 is the cheapest.

record.prompt_text:
### Exercise 7.10: Use estimation and approximation to solve problems

10. A caterer has to give a quote for the food at a wedding. The mother of the bride tells her that they are expecting adult 323 guests. She thinks about three quarters of the families will bring their children along. Most families have four children. The food will cost ₦3,960 per adult guest and about half price for a child. Work out a rough quote.
record.answer_text:
$$\begin{align}
\text{Number of families}&\approx \frac{323}{2} \\
&\approx \frac{320}{2} \\
&\approx 160\\
\end{align}$$
$$\begin{align}
\text{Number of children}&\approx \frac{3}{4}\times160 \times 4\\
&\approx 3\times160 \\
&\approx 480\\
\end{align}$$
$$\begin{align}
\text{Cost of food}&\approx 320\times ₦4,000+480\times \frac{₦4,000}{2} \\
&\approx 320\times ₦4,000+480\times ₦2,000 \\
&\approx  ₦1,280,000+₦960,000 \\
&\approx ₦2,260,000\\
\end{align}$$
